name: frontend-designer
description: Design, implement, diagnose, and quality-gate Optimizely interfaces with verified component and state conformance.

interface.shortDescription: Verified Optimizely interface design and implementation
interface.longDescription: A standalone frontend design skill for Optimizely product UI. It maps intent to current Axiom contracts, implements interfaces, diagnoses the owning layer of defects, and validates component states and rendered modes before completion.
defaultPrompt: Use frontend-designer to implement this interface with verified Axiom component and state contracts.
Review and fix this UI, then run the rendered conformance postflight.
Reconcile this Figma design with the installed Axiom version and implement it.
